summary: Iter32: backend testing 17/17 PASSED (test_iter32_employee_mgmt.py) covering Payroll RBAC (foreman 403 / anon 401-403), Employees create+archive+unarchive+delete cascade, include_archived filter, and foreman-forbidden mutations. Regression: iter28 (5/5) + iter30 (8/9*) + iter31 (12/12) green. Frontend: Wyplaty tab UI verified (modal opens, inputs accept text, archived list section, archive/unarchive/delete buttons render with correct data-testid), but Playwright submit of the Add modal kept toasting 'Podaj imie i nazwisko' even though the input value was correctly typed (`Name input value: TEST_UI32_*`) - suspected shadcn Input + autoFocus / React state sync race with Playwright clicks. Foreman page (/foreman) confirmed to contain ZERO 'Wyplaty' text. *iter30 has 1 collection import bug unrelated to this iter.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking [data-testid='payroll-add-submit'] via Playwright triggered the empty-name validation toast 'Podaj imie i nazwisko' even though the DOM input.value showed the typed name. Likely a shadcn Input + autoFocus + React controlled-value sync race when Playwright clicks the submit button too fast. Real users typing normally would not hit this. Workaround in tests: blur first (Tab) or wait ~500ms after typing. Backend POST /api/employees verified working via 17 backend tests.

action_items: (Optional) In AddModal handleAdd, also read input refs as fallback to avoid race when value/state sync hasn't completed for Playwright-driven submits.

(Pre-existing) Fix import path of /app/backend/tests/test_iter30_thumbnails.py to use relative import or run from /app/backend so `image_utils` resolves - test_make_thumbnail_reduces_size fails on collection from /app cwd.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/employees.py archive: uses datetime.now().isoformat() (naive, no tz) - acceptable here since other endpoints follow same pattern, but timezone-aware would be safer.
DELETE /employees cascade: 9 collections covered as spec (hour_entries, assignments, advances, penalties, absences, clothing_orders, bhp_documents, bhp_issuances, payroll_records). Good.
GET /employees: combined include_archived filter using $and+$or is correct and avoids excluding documents missing the is_archived field (legacy data).
Payroll endpoints all decorated with Depends(get_current_admin) - RBAC correctly enforced (verified via foreman token returning 403).
PayrollAdmin.js: archive/unarchive/delete use window.confirm() (native browser dialog) - functional but UX-wise a shadcn AlertDialog would be more consistent with the rest of the app.
Backend payroll list_payroll re-filters archived employees -- consistent with frontend hiding archived from main payroll table. Good.

success_rate.frontend: ~80% (modal renders, foreman view scrubbed, archive UI structure correct; submit click race for Add not fixed)
